_📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _💤 Low value_

**Tighten the `node-version` assertion.**

The regex `/node-version:\s*22\s/` also matches `node-version: 22.1`? No. It requires whitespace after `22`. A quoted value such as `node-version: "22"` would fail this check. The check also fails if `22` is the last characters of the file. Use a pattern that accepts optional quotes and line end.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-    expect(read(".github/actions/setup-gate/action.yml")).toMatch(/node-version:\s*22\s/);
+    expect(read(".github/actions/setup-gate/action.yml")).toMatch(/node-version:\s*["']?22["']?\s*$/m);
```
</details>
